input.query: SELECT month, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_active THEN user_id END) AS active_users, SUM(card_spend_eur) AS card_spend_eur, SUM(card_spend_eur) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_active THEN user_id END),0) AS spend_per_active_user, SUM(n_card_txns) AS card_txns, SUM(n_card_txns)*1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_active THEN user_id END),0) AS txns_per_active_user FROM fct_activity_monthly WHERE country = 'Romania' AND month >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND month < DATE '2026-06-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
